reviews.text: The prices are unbeatable. The wait times are brutal but they're worth it. The staff is caring and thorough. Just beware it's better to arrive before they're even open to save your spot.

Dr. Anna Parham and her team are wonderful people! They're caring, they take their time, they're informative, and super pleasant to deal with. Not to fail to mention that my Service Dog doesn't mind going there. She HATED the previous place that I took her to - that I will NEVER take her to again; an animal hospital that doesn't seem to place value on making the humans who take their animals there feel safe and cared for. Don't waste your time and hard earned money going to businesses that don't treat you like you matter. Go see Dr. Anna. She operates a first-rate affordable veterinary clinic. Because if you're like me - how you're treated as a paying customer is just as important as how your "baby/babies" will be cared for. You want to *feel* safe about who your special "child or children" with fur is/are receiving care from. Although they can't talk, they can definitely pick up on the energy of people and where they work. Don't be fooled by PetCare Express $9.00 office visit fee - that might make you think, "This place might not be any good". Because in this case the saying, "you get what you pay for", doesn't apply. Because THIS is definitely the place to go to for veterinary care. PetCare Express is the REAL safe haven for you and you 4-legged loved ones. Being respected and treated with care is worth everything. Because, as you know, you can't put a price on being respect and kindness. PetCare Express easily deserves a higher than 5/5-star rating! 10+ ⭐!
Amazing place with caring people. Michael and Levi are angels thank you so much for taking care of my sweet baby KUMA 🥹🥹🙏🏾🙏🏾🙏🏾 …
The best!!!
Best price for vaccinations only.

My favorite place I have been going to for years! Best prices! Office visit is $19.00! I love the veterinarians there a father and daughter! The only thing I don’t like is that you can’t make an appointment so the wait time can be long! I would advise to go on a Wednesday and be there a little before they open to get in line!

I like it cuz the service is good and the vet text come and and tell you everything that's going on in plain details. If you have any questions, they are more than willing to help you out to understand. The only thing I don't like is that when it's hot you have to wait in line outside due to the fact it is first come first serve. But other than that it is great.
Super Great to take your pet too. Great customer service 👏 our cat has been coming here for 4 years
Good doctors, but be prepared to wait for nearly 4-5 hours for simple procedures such as wellness, vaccinations etc - do not recommend for highly busy professionals

I want to express my sincere gratitude to veterinarian Maicol for his excellent work and professionalism. Thanks to him, I was able to travel with my two pets, Milo and Locky, from the United States to Colombia without any problems.

Everything went perfectly: their health certificates were in order, and the care he provided for my pets was exceptional. His commitment, dedication, and support made the entire process much smoother.

Thank you so much, Maicol! I wholeheartedly recommend him to anyone needing responsible and high-quality veterinary care.

You will definitely wait 5 hours or more to be seen. Be ready to wait . This place takes up an entire day. 3 times I waited longer than 3 hours and still wasn't seen. It's so very sad they do this instead of making appointments. Affordable if your really on a budget .

I had called to find out how far out appointments would be for a dental cleaning before driving up there for the consultation and was told that they have also stopped offering dental cleanings like the 43rd st location. They said it is because they are short staffed and have only 1 doctor at each location and part time techs. I had been trying to get in for over a year too. Bummer.
Takes so little to update your profile!!! Really would help not to have this business show as open when it’s not!

If you’re only going there for vaccines or other basic routine care, it’s a good place because their prices are pretty reasonable.

But be careful, because I honestly felt like this clinic is more focused on charging you for extra services. They attract you with low advertised prices, and then you end up with a much bigger bill.

I take my dog there for vaccines because those prices seem very reasonable. But when I was planning to travel with my dog, I needed health certificate. Their website listed the health certificate for $55, so I went in expecting something close to that.
When I arrived, I asked how much it would cost in total. They told me they didn’t know and that they’d let me know later. Then I waited for about three hours before it was finally my turn.

Once the vet saw me, I was suddenly told that the health certificate would cost $500. I was completely shocked. If that was the actual price, they should have told me before making me wait for three hours. It felt like they had wasted my time.

To be honest, it felt like a bait-and-switch. They advertise a $55 health certificate on their website, but then you end up being quoted $500 once you’re already there.
Pretty quick for a first-in, first-serve place.
It’s a clean place and they take care of you in a reasonable amount of time.
Wait time is long, be prepared. However, staff take their time with your pet and are extremely friendly. Well worth the wait!

Dr. Anna Parham and Pet Care Express are a rare find! The clinic is unique in its genuine concern for animals and its approach to affordable, quality care— something that is so hard to find these days. Amidst a slew of predatory veterinary practices that are in it only for the money, Dr. Parham is careful, caring, conscientious, and compassionate. We have trusted her for years with our beloved dog and have sent many others her way. 1000/10 recommend!

Called around 4:45  to get my puppy his shoots a lady answered the phone and said. They were about to close at 6 do they can only do vaccines and I said that's all I wanted and she told me to come in how far was I and I said I mins and she said ok. When I got there I was told they not seeing nobody else. And that's wrong for her to tell me to come there and when I get there they not taking anybody else and my puppy really needed his shoots I would not recommend this place they unprofessional and didn't want to help my puppy out at all I got information from a aminals hospital to call the state board on to make an complaint.

So I paid a visit to this West Holcombe location yesterday with my 13 year old
7 lb dog. He had a small rash on his body from scratching. Never had one before

The hair was totally gone from that area..
I have been going to the location since about 2013 with 2 small toy dogs
for mainly the rabies shots and maybe
an ear affection on the other dog.

Never have I had a problem like I did except yesterday . They wait time was unbelievable I got there around 11:30 and never left
until 5:30pm . No lunch , no water not even a crumb of food and I took an Uber 🤨

I was asked to pull a number which was 50 and the last person next to me was 51.
I heard the desk clerk said this is the cut off time no more. They told me I could go somewhere for a couple of hours and they would call when my turn comes.

Well! I had no where to go because I had no vehicle.. I told them I came by uber so I would sit and wait. Well! I waited and waited and waited and waited as I watched so many people come and go.

What is so ironic they never call the number you pull . They come out and call names so you never know who is who and what number they are at 🤔
By the time they got to me they took my dog and asked me what was I here for.
I told them the rash and slight wheezing.

My goodness! The young lady came back out after awhile with a long laundry list of charges totalling over $200.
She was talking so fast like a run away  train . I had to say slow down 🙆🏽

Antibiotics!  Allergy injection $62
heart worm test! Allergy fungus Shampoo
Rabies and pravo shot with boarding shot package,  heart worm pill for 30days
even though with a negative test.

Goodness! My head was spinning  🥴
I couldnt believe from a dermatologic skin rash I was told it could be a flee bite.

Unbelievable! To just come up with some diagnosis and said we are not sure.
Thank God there was no blood work because I would have left🤔

I got that bill down to $100 and look at some natural healings for dogs skin issues.
I really admire this place for so many years with the dad . He was very friendly and sociable and didnt over bill unnecessarily

I know times are changing and we are strapped in the USA with a horrible economy.. Electric Bills! Supplies!
have to be paid and salararies and your service but dont take advantage 😒

Some people able and some of us have a desperate need for sometype of discretion
I never got to go back with my dog or even meet the doctor. I was told its his daughter

I will miss the dad Dearly. Now! Its money money money through pushing lots of products. You feel  just like a hospital or doctor office visit . No different 🤦🏾🙏🏽
This Vet Clinic is Top Tier if you need your pet vaccinated! No extremely long wait, professional staff,and economically affordable prices. They serve the community well!!!!
Just want to acknowledge Micheal ! He is great! Thank you for helping my cat Skipper. Front desk is great too.  I didnt catch their names. I came May 27, 2026. They were both very kind too.
Such a great value. Office visits are $9
Best prices offering exceptional care. !
The vet and vet techs are so nice here. They genuinely care about animals so much and it shows. Great price too!

Horrible, I took time time off work and drove all the way there. I made sure to call ahead of time and check if they were open and if I should come in. They told me to come in and by the time I got there said they are no longer taking anymore patients. That makes no sense and they said they sporadically decide when to stop? What a waste of time super unprofessional
Very good

This is the best veterinarian I've ever been to.
If you want to get seen quickly get there one hour prior to opening.
Bring water 💧 and a snack because this veterinarian is very popular.
They are very through and ask lots of questions about your pet.
Prices are very low and fair.
An office visit is less than $15.
Medications 💊 are extra.
I can't say enough good things about this veterinarian, I'm totally impressed 👌.
My cat 🐈 even told me the veterinarian was the nicest veterinarian she had ever seen. She told me she didn't like the way they took her temperature because it was rude. She also said she liked the way the veterinarian messaged her ears 👂.
We have been coming here for 9 years and have been totally happy 😊 every time.
I'll see you there.

Very slow service.
3 hours and still waiting. Decent once they see you
They no longer provide teeth cleaning. 😔 …

A Diagnostic Virtuoso: The "Mozart" of Veterinary Medicine

As a retired Clinical Director who has spent a career hiring and evaluating medical professionals, I have an exceptionally high standard for clinical competence and professional integrity. For months, I searched for answers for my 123-pound gentle giant, Axel. I took him to several well-known clinics in Houston, but regrettably, they failed to find even the single mass I had discovered myself. They simply fumbled the opening statement.

Then, I found Dr. Anna Parham at PetCare Express on Holcombe Boulevard.

Dr. Parham is a true prodigy of her craft. While others relied on expensive overhead and corporate checklists, she used her hands and her clinical intuition—the soul of medicine that is clearly in her DNA. Within minutes, she identified three separate masses that the previous clinics had entirely missed. She performed a single FNA (Fine Needle Aspiration) to confirm the nature of the primary mass, while her expert clinical touch immediately identified the others as typical, benign lipomas. She gave us the unremarkable exam result we had been searching for.

From the moment we walked into PetCare Express, the entire staff was exceptionally warm, friendly, and helpful. In a high-pressure field, their genuine caring and support created a seamless, stress-free environment for both me and my dog. Dr. Parham found in minutes what high-priced hospitals missed for months. She recognized a client who values quality and met that standard with an honest, transparent diagnosis.

In a city of systemic predatory patterns, Dr. Anna Parham and the team at PetCare Express are a sanctuary of honesty. She is young, brilliant, and possesses a natural mastery of medicine that mirrors a virtuoso. Axel walked out a perfect patient, and I walked out knowing I have finally found the successor to the great legacy vets of Houston.

The prices are the only good thing about this place. They don’t let you go inside with your pet and they don’t take appointments. I been stuck here for almost 2 hours and they have not called my pet’s name yet. It goes by order which I understand but if you are planning on coming here come earlier than expected you might be stuck here for a good 2-3 hours.

Reviews • 40 ph... I've been going to the clinic for 5 years, and last week when I called to make an appointment, I asked for Jennifer Rivera and they told me she's no longer there. We really miss her; she was always very professional and attentive to my dog.

Really great experience with PetCare Express. The staff is super kind, knowledgeable, and takes the time to explain everything without being pushy. Dr. Anna is incredible—so compassionate and you can tell she truly cares.

I also appreciate how honest they are and how affordable the care is compared to other places. The wait can be a bit long since they take walk-ins, but it’s definitely worth it. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a reliable vet in Houston.

Over the past three weeks, we have brought our pets to this clinic and have noticed a significant change in the level of service compared to our previous experiences. When Dr. Parham (the father and owner) attended to our pet, the care was consistently excellent. We were able to request a private room, and he always took the time to speak with us directly, answer our questions thoroughly, and provide attentive, personalized care.

Recently, however, our visits with Dr. Anna Parham have been quite different. We have repeatedly been told that our pet needs to be seen in the back, with little to no direct interaction with the veterinarian. Even when we request a room, we are informed that the clinic is too busy—despite the lobby and parking lot often appearing nearly empty.

As pet owners, direct communication with the veterinarian is very important to us. The current process—relaying questions through a veterinary technician—can be frustrating and inefficient. It often results in incomplete answers and repeated back-and-forth, which adds unnecessary stress, especially when we have multiple concerns about our pet’s health.

Additionally, we noticed that Jennifer is no longer with the clinic. She consistently provided outstanding service and went above and beyond to ensure both pets and owners felt comfortable and informed. Her absence is definitely felt.

We truly value the level of care we previously received and hope the clinic can return to that standard of communication and attentiveness moving forward.

Wow! For such a low price, the entire service is excellent. The vaccines couldn't be cheaper, nor could the consultation. The results are very good, and the diagnoses are 99% accurate. I really liked the doctor who ran the clinic for years, and I think he retired or is retiring, and it seems his daughter, also a veterinarian, is now in charge. God willing, she'll be as good as her father.
Pet car express is awesome they where able to take care of both my dogs and get them on the best medication they needed . Dr. Anna is the best she really cares about your dogs!!

Pet Care Express on Holcombe Blvd truly helped my cat Sunkist when no one else could, and I can’t put into words how thankful I am for Dr. Anna and the entire team.
After going to other clinics and feeling like we were getting nowhere, I was exhausted and worried about my cat. From the moment we came to Pet Care Express, everything felt different. Dr. Anna actually took the time to listen, asked the right questions, and looked at the full picture instead of brushing things off. She treated Sunkist with so much gentleness and care, and for the first time, I felt real hope.
What sets them apart is that they don’t give up. Dr. Anna was thorough, compassionate, and determined to find answers when others couldn’t. The follow-up care was incredible — they checked in on Sunkist, adjusted care when needed, and made sure I never felt alone or unsure about what to do next.
Sunkist is more than just a cat to me — she’s family — and Pet Care Express treated her that way. If you’re feeling stuck, worried, or like you’ve run out of options for your pet, this is the place to go. Dr. Anna and her team truly care, and it shows in everything they do. I can’t recommend them enough.
Love this place for our Ace! They are reasonably priced and very thorough in explaining his care.
First visit today everything went great doctor and staff was amazing and services are very affordable i would recommend to bring your pet here .
Great people… simply put.

I had my dog's dental cleaning here and it was super affordable & easy and everyone was so nice. I would for sure recommend them to any pet owner. There is a wait to be seen so I'd make sure you have the time in the day.
Friendly staffs and well experienced doctors! Very affordable price. And the wait was never so long for us. Every time we go is normally only 10-30 mins waits.
Dr. Anna was knowledgable and kind. She was also very gentle with our dog which we appreciated. You can tell she truly cares about your pet. Highly recommend Dr. Anna and Petcare Express!

Dr. Anna is an amazing veterinarian! She is so kind, patient, and truly cares about both pets and their owners. She always takes the time to explain everything clearly and makes sure you feel comfortable with every step of the visit. You can tell she genuinely loves what she does, and it shows in the way she treats every animal. I’m so grateful to have her as my vet and highly recommend her to anyone looking for compassionate, trustworthy care.
Took my cats to get shots and grooming. They gave them back to me sedated barely breathing. Will nit use them again

Came here after learning the clinic offers very low office fees. Yes thats true. The system works where you line up and are handed a form with a number on it. Dogs who are sick get seen first so don't be alarmed or angry. Come here with patience please. The staff do their best to get the pets seen as soon as possible. I arrived at 9:40 and by 11:10 we were seen. What I liked best is I went in to have my dog's paw checked but the vet saw other issues that looked alarming and asked me to get an xray. She gave me a few other clinic recommendations however for this I'll take my dog back to his regular vet for xrays and more alarming issues. Would I come back, yes! Would I recommend this place, yes! Do they do many procedures here, no. Recommendation for the clinic: front desk can smile more. It really helps when all staff feel happy to be there because cat/dog owners don't want to be at the vet's. They want to be home with their fur baby. Having a welcoming staff eases tension and reassures patients they are in the right spot.

Love this clinic!  The employees are all knowledgeable and care about their clients and their clients pet's.  I would not have been able to afford this at another vet clinic so I am grateful this place even exists.

As a former vet tech, and someone that sporadically does rescue work, I HIGHLY recommend bringing your pets here.
They never answer the phone. It is so hard to get them on the line.
They are great with service in person but no one answers the phone ever so it is almost impossible to get someone.

I take all 3 of my dogs.  Staff is friendly and
Knowledgeable.
No appts but Thursday afternoons are the least bust time
Best pet vet they always treat my pets with kindness
Been going here for years. Love them.  Sadly just like everything else. Prices are going up and they’re adding more fees and required tests to make up for inflation.  Still great place
Amazing service! Worth the wait.
Great job
Knowledgeable and friendly staff. The cost of my bill was reasonable.

Extremely incompetent. I never saw a vet. They took my cat to the back, said they did a test but I got no results. They don't have a bathroom so you have to walk around the block to a restaurant to go to the bathroom. I think that's a violation actually for a business not to have a bathroom available. I highly recommend going elsewhere.

Well worth the wait
You can’t find better care .. and price is surprisingly low

Good price, and they seem friendly with but they made me administer the vaccines to my dog. I never heard of a clinic giving up. The result being my dog pulled to the oral vaccine they gave me (I didn't understand why they can't give them the shots under the skin) and now, effectively I probably paid for vaccines that my dog puked up. Not sure I'll be coming back.

Some of the best and most reasonable prices in all greater Houston.

I highly recommend this vet office they will take good care of your pet

This place has severely suffered since the father retired and the rude daughter took over. I’ve brought my pups in for years and now they’re forcing services that aren’t needed just to make more money. They’re no longer seeing pets and allowing the option to use muzzles to check injuries, they’re requiring you to pay for sedation to have their wounds examined instead. And this is what I was told without the vet even physically seeing my dog. He was in the car while the techs and manager talked to me inquiring about the reason for our visit and attempted to gaslight me in regards to my questions for their reasoning. I’m happy to take my business elsewhere after these type of inflated, forced changes and horrible customer service. This is my 2nd unsatisfactory encounter. There won’t be an opportunity for a third. Ask the right questions before spending your money or wasting your valuable time.
Very professional and extremely nice staff!
Great place for vaccination and brief check up. They're very helpful and their reports are very well detailed.

Today was our first visit to Petcare Express. It was hands down the best experience I've ever had at a vet. We adopted a dog recently and needed to get her shots, etc. After checking in, we were told we could wait in our car. Our puppy was scared, so that was a good option. While there, our car/battery had issues and we had to call AAA. Of course, we were called for our appointment while the technician was still working on my car. Jenifer came out to help us, worked with our situation, (which she totally didn't have to) went above and beyond, and couldn't have been more nice. She even brought my daughter and I water and a fruit punch. It's just super rare to experienced such kindness from a stranger; she really made my day and saved my butt. Thank you Jenifer and everyone at Petcare Express!

If you're looking for economical quality and trustworthy pet care, this is the spot. Highest care options for beloved pets at a quarter of the normal cost. However, be prepared that their locations are popular and we'll known, be prepared to sit and wait. The vets take their time with each patient. Established customers know its a great idea to arrive early prior to opening and wait in line to ensure you're seen quickly. Don't go when in a hurry, you will need to spend the wait time with your fluffy baby. The facilities may be dated, but the care and pharmacy availability are excellent.
Best clinic. Stuff is so helpful and friendly.  Prices are as low as they possibly could be.
Very busy but always Friendly good service! Best part very affordable and professional.

BEST PLACE EVER! I have been having a great experience since day 1 with these wonderful people Dr. Anna & Jennifer are nothing short of amazing & so is the gentleman with the glasses I can’t think of his name but you will definitely know his warm kind presence when you’re there! They genuinely care about your pets & your pockets finally someone who doesn’t try to get over on people with insane costs & unnecessary tests. My cat Buddy is currently undergoing FIP treatment & they have gave me hope & are helping me so much through this process. I thank God for these people. Definitely bring your pets here!
You do have to get there early but these guys are quick, knowledgeable and courteous with resonance prices. I would take my pet back there anytime.
I’ve been calling this location for 3 days trying to schedule a service and no one ever answers the phone nor is there an option through the website. Taking this as a sign to take my pet elsewhere
Dr. Parham is great!! Been going here many years. These Dr's actually genuinely care about animals and the animals they treat. Their prices have always stayed affordable. I'd definitely recommend.

2025 update-Brought several dogs over the years since 1st post. Last dog  yrs ago. Price is reasonable, staff professional & helped son with rescue dog he wanted that had heartworm. HE had connected to this dog & wasn't giving up. Clinic helped him have 5 more years. Katrina rescue dog.

If you just need shots, you'll be in and out. If you have a sick dog that doesn't feel like being there (like you when you are sick with flu) YOU WILL WAIT HOURS. Better to go somewhere else. Brought my dog back b/c she was getting worse and waited 1.5 + hrs. Told 'soon' STILL WAITING

This was my favorite place when Dr. Gordon was there!!! He started the low cost vet clinics and what a visionary!!! He worked his butt off and was so wonderful. Now that he’s retired, they’ve changed hours, close when they want, etc. they close at 7:00, they say, but if you get there at 6:15, even if it’s empty, they won’t see you. Just not into service.
Happy Gordon made his money!!! Just not the same!! 😢🤬

Long wait times. Not sure why it’s called express. I signed in, left after waiting for 20 min and they called me a hour later telling me they were ready to see my pet. Too bad they don’t accept appointments.
I have been taking all my babies there for years! They have excellent caring staff, from the front to the nurses and the vets. Thank you for being so kind to all my babies every single time they go❤️
Great service

This is my 2nd time the first time the one by Jersey City, but no cleaning there anymore, the down side is they don't answer the phone, had to drive from Katy texas just to get the appointment. But the price is great.

My cat, Juicy, just needed his vaccinations. I got there at 8a and waited in my car. I was 2nd in the parking lot. Since he just needed shots, I was out by 10:45. They open at 10. If you need to see the doctor for a sick visit, I suggest getting there early. like stupid early. Clear your schedule. Bring snacks, a book or something while you wait before they open. It is a low cost clinic and they don't do appointments. I believe techs can do the vaccines so the pets are in and out faster for that service. If you don't get there early be prepared to wait and be patient. The staff was super nice and the clinic was clean. I will most definitely bring my cat here again.

Probably the best deal you can get for dental cleaning. The initial check-up appointment can be hard to wait for (we waited 3 hours). But once you’re registered in their system, you can book the dental cleaning appointment with them. They did a great job on my pup and I’m super happy with the prices. We were quoted 500-1000+ base prices at other places with equivalent amount of wait time (1 month).  Would definitely come here again for dental cleaning.

This place is truly a hidden gem. It’s incredible that a clinic like this exists—making pet care genuinely affordable without compromising on quality. I was able to get all the preventatives my golden retriever needed at a remarkably low cost. The staff, especially the vet techs, were so kind, helpful, and completely transparent throughout the process. The only downside is that they operate on a walk-in-only basis, so I’d recommend planning your visit accordingly. Overall, I highly recommend this place!
They are absolutely amazing!! Great service, they’re very attentive and they do care about the animals.

I have been calling for two days straight due to an overcharge and the phone just rings until it gets to a full mailbox.  Regardless of what time i call, it just rings.  Called at 6:30pm a final time yesterday, phone still just rings!!
I like the clinic, but be prepared to be there for 3 hours.
Great service!
Excellent and reliable service

Walk in, no appointment so sometimes you wait but the pricing cannot be beat. Taking dogs and cats to Dr. Parham for 15 years. He has now retired but his daughter, Dr. Parham and biz partner Dr. Banfield are almost as good as he was lol. He just had seen more. Front desk is patient and medtech talk to your babies when they take them for their shots. They do have pvt rooms when necessary

I took my little baby to Pet Express for a tooth abscess on 5-23-25. The staff and doctors are so caring and treated my little Precious as a prized pup. Precious was a champion because she has grown familiar with staff and trust them. You may have to wait a while for care but it is well worth the wait Pet Express all of your staff truly care about animals. I will not be going anyplace else.

I love this place so much!! I just drove 800 miles from Atlanta to Houston to bring my boy, Simba, to see Dr. Anna (Parham) after he spent two traumatic nights in a veterinary ER in Atlanta. Dr. Anna has always treated him with so much love and with respect for his anxiety around vet visits. He was still in crisis, but I was also concerned for his mental health, and she was brilliant on all counts!!

Dr. Anna gets down on the floor with him and speaks so softly. She lets me hold him when she draws blood and gives him injections. It’s such a corrective experience for him (and for me). And she’s the best at diagnosing and treating illness which, in our recent situation, was multifaceted.

I’ve loved her dad for many years, but Simba responds better to women, and I’m so grateful to have found both of them. Simba is responding well, thankfully, and I owe it all to Dr. Anna.

Wonderful team! Certainly not an upscale looking place HOWEVER the team there is OUTSTANDING & HONEST! they took great care of my pet and made honest recommendations; my pet has a particular condition which they cannot treat but they did give me a list of veterinary offices that specialize in her condition- this reassured me they care more about the pet rather than making money.
It's really affordable, but it takes a while to get seen if your dog is sick. Nice people and trustworthy.

Get there early! They open at 10 but the line forms before that. We arrived at 9:15 and were the 9th one in line. I brought a chair and a leash for my pup. Once they open it moves pretty fast. We were done by 11:15. Great staff and prices!!
Wait times at this place are out of control. You’ll have to miss a whole day of work just to get your pet seen. Extremely slow staff and also kinda rude.

They don’t have practices in place for when their systems go down. Or initiative to make a plan rather than let furbabies sit outside in the heat. What happened to using pen & paper to let people sign-in, and let them wait inside? Lack of common sense or empathy? Or both?

They don’t answer the phone which is also frustrating. I came here to get my dog's vaccines updated and now he'll probably get sick from how dirty it is outside.  I'm sure he'll have a hot spot flare up from coming here.  They eventually closed after an hour of their internet being down. Waste of time and realize they don't care about you or your pet.

Check out Low Cost Pet Vax for other affordable vaccine options without having to pay for an office visit.

very friendly & attentive staff. the wait isn't bad considering it's walk-in only, and the lobby is comfortable & clean. the care is very thorough and very affordable. Luke & Jeffery were wonderful :-]

Poor service, poor treatment of both staff and dogs. More than 5 hours of waiting, supposedly because they don't have a room to attend to them, but staff arrive and attend to them. I've been here for over 5 hours and nothing.

Terrible service, starting with the receptionist who speaks sarcastically as if she doesn't care about the time of the people there. Second, I arrived at 1 pm sharp and left at 4 pm and they didn't attend to me. They distribute arrival queues, they put sheets with a number on them that are supposed to be the appointment number for the day, but it doesn't matter if you're first or last because they call whoever they want. I really don't recommend this place to anyone; the hygiene is quite unpleasant. You get what you pay for, I admit my mistake. I advise anyone who goes there to bring medication for anxiety and stress. Without a doubt, the worst clinic you can find in Houston.

This clinic's service is terrible, especially the express service. They have absolutely no service; they take forever to attend to patients and even longer to process payments. They don't follow any order of arrival. I truly do not recommend it in the slightest.

I’ve gone back and forth about posting my experience but I feel if it can save even one pet owner from experiencing the tragedy and loss that I had to endure here, it’s worth it.

On Tuesday January 28, 2025 I brought my 10 y.o. cat in for a routine dental cleaning at this clinic. She was healthy as a horse, I took better care of that cat than I did my own health. My cat unexpectedly and tragically passed away as she was being sedated for the dental cleaning. I’m convinced this was due to negligence and veterinarian malpractice. They called me during the workday to tell me my cat had gone into cardiac arrest and died in their care. They couldn’t give me any sort of reason as to what went wrong or why she went into cardiac arrest. They had even completed the physical prior to sedating her and said they saw nothing to indicate she could not go through with the procedure. I’m convinced this was something to do with an overdose or not running the proper tests prior to the dental cleaning procedure. Dr. Gordon Parham called me to let me know the terrible news and there seemed to be very little empathy or consolation on his side other than letting me know that they would cover the cost of cremation (if you ask me, that’s the least they could do).

I’m still in shock and disbelief, months later and I am still reeling from this loss that I believe could have been prevented by going to a more reputable veterinarian. This clinic was recommended to me as it’s known for its affordable dental cleanings, but if you ask me, it’s worth the extra money to go to somewhere that’s not going to be an express low cost clinic, with older facilities and staff that potentially cut corners or do not have legitimate licensing/credentials.

TLDR: this clinic killed my cat and if you care at all about your fur babies, please fork out a little extra money to go somewhere more reputable. Don’t cut corners when it comes to the LIFE of your pet. We entrust vets to provide care and medical attention to our babies, it’s the most important decision we make for their health, don’t make the same mistake I did! I paid the ultimate price. My baby is now resting in eternal peace, but I will forever live with the guilt and sadness. Rest in peace Eevee.

My cat Mooshu and I had such a great experience this evening with PetCare Express. It is affordable, a walking clinic, and every single staff member I came in contact with was kind, empathetic, and knowledgeable. I came in this evening devastated believing my male cat had a UTI which can be very costly and fatal- luckily because of their low cost I was able to get Mooshu the care he needed without worrying about breaking the bank (sometimes UTI’s and blockages can cost thousands- I was able to pay less than $100.00 this evening). I have seen several reviews upset about staff not being able to answer the phones- luckily I had no issues when I called twice this evening but I cannot emphasize enough that this is a low-cost clinic and majority of individuals who come in are walk-in clients. It is a smaller facility compared to huge vet hospitals and they do not have dedicated call center representatives to answer each call. While in the waiting room I observed two lovely ladies who did their best and a great job managing the calls coming in and the clients who were there in person. I am so thankful to the all the wonderful staff who helped Mooshu tonight and kept me calm.
